title: Tanjiro - Take It Real Slow (velocity edit)

shots.title: The Mark
shots.desc: Extreme close-up of the eye and flame mark. Opens from black with a 2-frame white flash.
shots.fx: B&W, red kept in the eye. Slow push-in 100 to 108%.

shots.title: Alone in the Ruins
shots.desc: Wide shot: Tanjiro stands alone in the burning ruins, looking up.
shots.fx: Desaturated, embers keep their orange. Slow push-in.

shots.title: Looking Up
shots.desc: Low-angle shot of his chin and throat. He's staring at the sky.

shots.title: The Stare
shots.desc: His head drops and he locks eyes with the camera. Bloody face.
shots.fx: Desaturated, blood stays red. Shake on the head-drop.

shots.title: Eye Flash
shots.desc: Red eye close-up, a quick glimpse of what's coming.
shots.fx: The only full-color frame in the intro: a red flash that teases the drop.

shots.title: Grit
shots.desc: In the forest, gritting his teeth through the pain.

shots.title: Breathe
shots.desc: Eyes close. Hold for 2 beats while the music drops out.
shots.fx: Slow-mo at 0.7x. Very slow push-in. Vignette darkens.

shots.title: Into the Pupil
shots.desc: The camera dives into his pupil until it fills the frame.
shots.fx: 2x speed plus an extra zoom to 140% with zoom blur, ending on a white flash.

shots.title: Sun Burst
shots.desc: The sun burst explodes on the word "F*ck it".

shots.title: Ring of Fire
shots.desc: Tanjiro spins through the sun-breathing ring of fire.

shots.title: Scream
shots.desc: He screams; red light everywhere.

shots.title: Crimson Slash
shots.desc: A pink-red fire slash rips across the frame on "Let's go".

shots.title: Petals
shots.desc: Gritted teeth with petals and sparks flying past.

shots.title: Take It Real Slow
shots.desc: Arms raised for the strike, slowed down to match the lyric.
shots.fx: Slow-mo at 0.5x on "take it real slow". Slow push-in.

shots.title: Cross Cut
shots.desc: A fire cross slashes open on black.
shots.fx: 1.6x speed. White flash at the cross.

shots.title: Bloodied
shots.desc: Bloodied snarl, now in full color (calls back the B&W shots).
shots.fx: Full saturation (same shot as #4, but in color). Punch-zoom.

shots.title: Fire Trail
shots.desc: Fire races across the ground through the dark forest.

shots.title: Sky Ring
shots.desc: Ring of fire against the night sky.

shots.title: Water vs Blood
shots.desc: A water slash cuts through a red backdrop.

shots.title: Engulfed
shots.desc: Tanjiro surrounded by pink flames.

shots.title: Scream II
shots.desc: The scream again: the loop trick from Ref A.

shots.title: Grin
shots.desc: Extreme close-up of his gritted teeth, pulling out to his face.

shots.title: Pillar of Light
shots.desc: A pillar slash, then the light dome explodes.

shots.title: The Mark (Ignited)
shots.desc: Bookend: the eye from shot #1, now burning in full color.
shots.fx: Push-in, then a hard cut to black on the beat.

shots.title: Black
shots.desc: Black screen while the song tails off. Shorts loops back to shot #1.
